text_block_list.text: Phew... That hit the spot.
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Huh? Спешл Уик... You're not going
back for more?
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Oh, yeah. Five bowls will do... Sorry, I
should head out.
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Aaah! Stop, stop! I can't be homesick
already! I just got here!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: (Does her stomach hurt, maybe?)
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Сайленс Судзука, sorry to disturb you during
your meal, but can I have a
moment?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: Huh? Oh, yes... What is it?
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
It's about this weekend's planned
scrimmage. There's an open spot.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I know you were previously injured, and
this scrimmage seems like a
good
opportunity to get you back on the track.
What do you think?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Racing in the scrimmage? Um... Well, yes...
If it means I can run...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: Oh...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Isn't it ironic? I came to this school and
started entering races because
I love
running. But that's exactly what lead to my
injury.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Something wrong? Are you still not feeling
up to it, perchance?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Ah, um... Sorry. Can I have a little time to
think?
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
...I see. Very well, then. I certainly won't
force you. But let me know as
soon as
you've made your decision.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: All right... Good night, Спешл Уик.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: Yeah, good night, Suzuka.
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
(Tomorrow will bring more classes and
training... Will I be able to get
the hang of
things? Or...)
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
(I really do want to race, but if I get
injured again at the scrimmage...)
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: Siiigh...
text_block_list.name: Suzuka and Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Hm-hm-hmmm. ♪ What to do? What to
do? ♪ Wonder if I can find
something fun.
To. Dooo—Oh!
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text:
Hey! New! Giiirl! What's up? Gotten used
to the academy yet?
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text: Oh, Teio...
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: Huh? Why are you looking so glum?
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text:
Gotcha. So that's what's got you down in
the dumps.
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text: I thought I was prepared to face some tough challenges here, but this is beyond anything I could have imagined... Sigh...
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: Hmm, I see, I see... Yeah!
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text: This won't do!
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text: Wh-what?!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: This won't do! Won't do at all!
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text:
I know the classes and training sessions are
hard here, and I get that
you're stressed
because everyone's so fast...
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text: But if that's what the academy represents to you, then that's a real shame!
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text: It is? Really?
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: Yup! And I'll tell you why.
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text:
You still haven't learned the very best
thing about this place!
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text: The best thing? What could that be?
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: If you wanna know... come with me!
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text: Huh?! Ah, wait, Teio!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: Come on! Hurry up and follow me!
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text:
W-wait, please! Huh? Why am I getting
déjà vu?!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик
